evals.name: audit-repo-skills
evals.prompt: Audit the skills in C:\src\my-skills and tell me what to fix. Don't change anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Runs audit-skills.ps1 with -Root, reads the log, scores flagged skills A–L, writes the report, and makes no edits.

assertions.text: runs scripts/audit-skills.ps1 against the given root rather than counting by eye
scores skills against the rubric criteria by letter
orders proposed changes with description trims first

evals.name: trim-description-keep-triggers
evals.prompt: The heic-to-jpeg description is 726 characters. Trim it.
evals.expected_output: Cuts workflow narration, keeps every trigger phrase, and says a trigger eval should confirm no regression.

assertions.text: keeps every trigger phrase the user might type (convert HEIC, iPhone photos, HEIF to JPG, .heic files)
removes narration such as how the script works
says to verify triggering with a should-trigger and near-miss eval set

evals.name: new-skill-is-skill-creator
evals.prompt: Create a new skill that formats SQL files.
evals.expected_output: Says creating skills is skill-creator's job; offers a rubric pass after.

assertions.text: does not start an audit of existing skills
